Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within United States

Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. Since we launched Mercury in 2019, our customer base has grown to over 300,000 startups and small businesses from all around the world. This turns out to be a pretty wild endeavor, so we’re looking to bring someone smart onto our Customer Support team to help us out.

As a member of our Customer Support team, you’ll make sure our users are charmed by warmth and competence when they have questions or needs that aren’t being met by our product. You’ll radiate intelligence while exercising your best human qualities, like compassion and empathy, even in the face of frustration.

You’ll need to understand how our product works in detail. Banking* has a lot of moving pieces, so this is harder than it might seem. Finding efficient, elegant solutions for problems stemming from the oft-convoluted U.S. financial system isn’t always easy, but if you’re good at your job, our users will never know it.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

What You’ll Do:

- Answer user questions over chat, email, and phone

- Handle user account requests, including application processing, card disputes, missing payments, card shipments, and a whole lot more

- Teach customers how to use our product (hopefully most of it is self-explanatory), and translate user confusion into product suggestions

- Identify the systemic flaws that lead to user problems

- Work with our engineering team to find and squash bugs

- Communicate our users' needs to our partner banks and work with them to improve their products and processes

- Write help articles and FAQs

- Learn our internal tools and figure out how to improve them

- Put in place processes to make your job more efficient

- Help with other compliance and customer tasks

- Create and sustain warm relationships with our users

- Help build out the customer support and ops infrastructure at Mercury

What You Bring:

- Have 2+ years of experience in a Customer Experience / Customer Support role

- Consistently exercise empathy

- Always seek to answer the question behind the question

- Understand how to translate complex terminology into clear, human user communication

- Enjoy thinking about how to automate as much of your job as possible

- Keep a clean, ordered inbox

- Stay calm and collected while working on ten things at once

- Feel confident talking with startup folks in person, over chat, or on the phone

- Use creativity while working within difficult constraints

- Show kindness in the face of unpleasantness (our customers generally are really great, but they can get passionate when it comes to their businesses)

Would be nice if you:

- Have experience working in retail branch banking

- Are passionate about uncovering customer needs

- Enjoy solving customer problems and proactively offering solutions to unmet needs

Schedule Information:

- Required: be available to work at least one weekend day per 5 day shift

- We are currently hiring for multiple shifts. Openings will be covered early in the interview process

- Your working schedule will be fixed - this is long-term commitment, not a rotating shift

- Assist customers and internal teams with inquiries, troubleshoot complex issues, and provide solutions with a focus on providing exceptional service

As a key part of our team, you’ll help us create a world-class support experience and ensure our customers feel heard, supported, and delighted every time they interact with us.

Headquarters: New York, NY (Remote)

Our mission at Talkspace is to help people heal. To get there, we need exceptionally passionate, bright, and motivated people. Want to help over one million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Clinical Quality Specialist to join our Network and Clinical Quality team. As a Clinical Quality Specialist, you'll lead peer proficiency reviews, contribute to quality improvement initiatives, and provide essential clinical support for network providers. Your expertise will create a substantial impact in upholding the highest standards of care.

To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

*This is a remote position based on Eastern Time with a Monday - Friday daytime schedule.

What You’ll Do

- Peer Proficiency Review

- Conduct room/documentation audits to investigate complaints and determine the validity of findings and evaluate improvement opportunities and risk

- Assist with Interrater Reliability initiative

- Develop and evolve criteria used to evaluate clinical quality

- Clinical Support

- Support providers in network with clinical issues and connect them with peer consultants as needed

- Coordinate with CMO, SVP, Network, Director of Clinical & Quality, and/or Manager of Quality to support execution of special clinical projects

- Assist with clinical risk management

- Provide clinical support cross-departmentally

- Quality Management

- Coordinate with Quality Management about room/documentation audits to guide practitioner action plans

- Assist with the development of clinical policy and procedures

- Assist with provider performance monitoring and remediation

- Engage in quality improvement initiatives as needed

- Performs other related duties as assigned

About You

- Current license to practice independently without supervision (e.g. Professional Counselor, Licensed Mental Health Counselor, Social Worker, Marriage and Family Counselor, Psychologist) with diagnostic privileges

- 5+ years of clinical experience

- 2+ years experience in telehealth and QA

- Experience with high acuity clients preferred

- Demonstrated understanding of how AI is used in/impacts the clinical field preferred

Benefits

- Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans coverage

- Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA

- 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching

- Voluntary benefits

- Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care

- Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment

- Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events

- Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $75,000 and $80,000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the most comprehensive and convenient way to take care of your mental health and wellness, focused on providing quality mental health services on your own terms.

Our signature psychotherapy and psychiatry product connects individual users with a network of thousands of licensed mental health providers through an easy-to-use and HIPAA-compliant web and mobile platform. With Talkspace, users can connect their dedicated provider via live video, text, or phone.

Backed by over 10 years of industry-leading research and clinically proven results, our accessible care model continues to make huge strides in lowering the barriers to quality mental healthcare services nationwide. Talkspace is the top insurance-covered therapy service with over 112 million Americans covered and a leader within the Corporate Wellness Space, with more than 200 employer partnerships across several industries.

Our focus to help people feel better starts at Talkspace, where we connect and collaborate as a team to make the world a better place. Fun company-wide events, happy hours, wellness perks, flex PTO, access to Talkspace products, and competitive benefits are just some of the ways we make Talkspace a great place to work. Do you want to save the world? Come join us!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification, if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

The Customer Experience (CX) team sits at the center of Instacart’s support ecosystem, serving our diverse community of consumers, shoppers, retailers, and advertisers through both direct support and scalable solutions. We partner closely with cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, and Operations to surface insights from the front line, reduce friction in the customer journey, and shape future roadmaps.

We deliver empathetic, high-quality support through a blend of data-driven, operational excellence. By focusing on clear communication, critical thinking, and continuous improvement, we ensure that every customer interaction not only resolves the immediate issue but also consistently enhances the overall Instacart experience.

About the Job

- This role plays a vital part in supporting our consumers, shoppers, retailers, and advertisers. We are currently hiring for a variety of shifts, including morning, mid-day, and evening coverage, to ensure we provide seamless service throughout the day. Schedule flexibility—including availability for evenings, weekends, and holidays—is essential to meeting the diverse needs of our community.

- Handle live customer contacts (phone, chat, and/or email) for up to 100% of your scheduled time, consistently delivering clear, empathetic, and efficient support.

- Navigate and execute complex workflows using established tools, policies, and knowledge base content to resolve a wide range of order and account issues.

- Resolve edge cases by carefully following documented procedures, seeking guidance when needed, and escalating to the appropriate teams when issues fall outside standard paths.

- Conduct thorough investigations into customer issues—reviewing account history, order details, and prior interactions—to ensure accurate and fair outcomes.

- Create internal transfer tickets and document cases with clear, detailed notes so downstream teams have the context they need to resolve issues efficiently.

- Proactively identify patterns, pain points, and process gaps in day-to-day work, and provide concrete suggestions and recommendations to supervisors and pillar leadership.

- Act as a positive team player and informal leader by modeling best practices, sharing tips and insights with peers, and contributing to a supportive, inclusive team environment.

- Surface emerging issues and operational challenges (such as tooling bugs, policy ambiguities, or contact spikes) to leadership quickly and with clear examples, helping the team respond and adapt in real time.

About You

Minimum qualifications

- High school diploma or equivalent (some college or specialized training a plus)

- 1+ year in a customer-facing role (support, retail, hospitality, call center, etc.) with a track record of strong service

- Fluency in French, both spoken and written

- Comfort handling live contacts for most of the day (phone, chat, and/or email) in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including clear documentation of cases and transfers, attention to detail and ability to follow established workflows

- Problem-solving mindset with the ability to investigate issues, interpret account/order details, and make sound judgments within policy

- Emotional intelligence and resilience when dealing with upset or frustrated customers and complex situations

- Basic technical proficiency (navigating multiple systems, CRM tools, browser-based applications, and common productivity tools like Google Workspace)

- Schedule flexibility to support evenings, weekends, and holidays based on business needs

- Comfort working with AI-assisted tools and willingness to adopt new technologies that enhance customer support workflows and drive efficiency

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in a contact center or multi-channel support environment (phone + chat + email)

- Prior exposure to complex, policy-heavy workflows (e.g., financial services, logistics, e‑commerce, or marketplaces)

- Familiarity with CRM and contact center tools (Salesforce, Genesys/Ujet, Zendesk, etc.)

- Demonstrated experience surfacing trends or issues to leadership and proposing improvements

- Proven ability to work collaboratively on a team, share best practices, and provide peer support or informal mentorship

Work Schedule

- Full-time | 40 hours per week

- Operations run 7 days a week | 7:00 AM – 11:00 PM EST / 4:00 AM – 8:00 PM PST

Shift assignments are based on business needs. Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays is required.

Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes. We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well.

While our headquarters are based in Denver, Colorado, our team spans the globe, with teammates across Brazil, Poland, the Philippines, Mexico, and beyond. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, people and Pros grow and succeed together—no matter where they’re based. Leadership is as focused on growing team members’ careers as they expect their teams to be on creating solutions for Pros.

We also offer:

- Paid holidays and flexible, take-it-as-you-need-it scheduled time off

- A culture built on innovation that values big ideas, no matter where they come from

Role Overview:

As a Specialist, Onboarding, you are a professional who thrives in ensuring a seamless and positive onboarding experience for our service professionals (our Pros) to our platform. About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

The role

As a regulated payment provider, we must ensure we manage operational risk and our regulatory requirements correctly. We do this by having a robust control framework across some of our business-critical areas, like payments and billing.

This role will be central to ensuring our 1st line Operations teams continue to implement, manage, test and regularly update controls frameworks. You'll manage the end-to-end controls framework for our operational teams, including but not limited to Payments Operations, Billing and Credit Control. You will be a key point of contact for managing our annual Safeguarding and SOC1 audits, engaging with auditors and gathering and submitting evidence.

The role provides an excellent opportunity to work with the broader Enterprise Risk community and shape the controls environment for a fast-growing FinTech, putting your stamp on how controls are designed, implemented and managed.

What excites you

- Designing and implementing controls. Working with the Regulatory Compliance team to understand the complete picture of the control landscape and then collaborating with 1st line control owners in our Operation to implement relevant controls

- Control assessment and reporting. Updating the safeguarding and SOC1 controls assessments on a regular cadence

- Direct control management. Managing key controls within our Internal Operations teams

- Understanding existing processes and re-designing controls to meet current and future business needs

- Working with the Regulatory team to ensure audits are completed successfully, including explaining our first-line controls to auditors and regulators

- Improving efficiency through the standardisation, automation or removal of controls

- Building positive relationships with stakeholders across the different lines of defence to help develop a real understanding of our risk exposure, control environment, deficiencies and gaps

- Autonomy to drive change from the ground up

What excites us

- Have worked in a regulated environment, preferably financial services or at a FinTech

- Previous experience working in a similar role, such as Audit, you’re skilled in designing, implementing and testing the effectiveness of controls

- You're a great communicator. You can simplify and clearly explain the what and why behind the controls you implement

- You understand how to balance compliance and operational efficiency

- You have a solid understanding of the three lines of defence and have experience working with Regulatory Compliance teams as well as external auditors

- You have great attention to detail, you work in a structured manner and you’re comfortable with data

- You’re comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where your responsibilities can evolve and change

- You're a self-starter and can work independently with minimal supervision

In addition to running the daily experience, this role will support the cultural moments that punctuate the year: monthly office events, onsites hosted in NYC, and annual celebrations. You'll join a team that creates thoughtful, memorable moments for our employees with the same care we put into our products, and you'll partner closely with the broader People team, IT, and Finance on the larger operational pieces. Because our team is lean, your impact will be immediate — you'll set the tone for how Mercury's New York hub feels to the people in it.

Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do

We're hiring a Revenue Operations Specialist to connect Sales, Growth and Technology through reliable data, processes and working software. You'll own core sales operations and build, deploy and maintain applications, integrations and AI workflows that improve pipeline generation and conversion.

- Find funnel bottlenecks. Partner with RevOps, Sales and Growth on prospecting, qualification, account assignment, pipeline generation and conversion.

- Prioritize practical solutions. Translate ambiguous needs into engineering requirements and measurable success criteria, weighing commercial impact, implementation effort and maintenance.

- Build connected applications. Develop and deploy internal tools linking CRM, sales engagement, enrichment providers and spreadsheets through APIs, webhooks and code.

- Automate with AI. Build account-research, enrichment, qualification, call-analysis and sales-enablement workflows with appropriate human review.

- Keep solutions reliable. Debug failures, test changes, manage dependencies and restore functionality as requirements, APIs and models evolve.

- Protect business data. Apply controls for customer data, credentials, access permissions, security and AI usage costs.

- Own everyday sales operations. Maintain accurate CRM data, workflows, reporting and clear account ownership alongside development projects.

- Measure commercial impact. Validate cross-system metrics; track time saved, errors, lead response, adoption and pipeline outcomes.

- Make adoption sustainable. Document purpose, dependencies, operation and recovery; create practical guides, gather user feedback and improve solutions.

How you'll work

You'll work with RevOps, Sales and Growth leaders to turn commercial problems into deployable solutions, explaining technical choices and limitations in business terms.

Using CRM data, SQL, Google Sheets and AI coding tools, you'll build and validate workflows, checking generated code and production behavior rather than relying on prompting alone.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves

- Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Growth Operations, Business Systems or comparable business-and-technical experience.

- Understanding of B2B funnels, inbound and outbound motions, segmentation, pipeline generation and conversion.

- Experience deploying and maintaining applications, integrations or automations used by others; independent projects and relevant portfolios count.

- Working proficiency in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, including reading, writing, debugging and maintaining code.

- SQL querying, joins, validation and analysis; strong Google Sheets skills covering lookups, pivot tables, logical formulas and data manipulation.

- REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, failure handling and synchronization.

- Git, deployment, environment variables, secrets management, logging, testing, dependency management and recovery.

- Hands-on AI-assisted development with Claude, DeepSeek, Codex or comparable tools, including reviewing code, validating behavior and troubleshooting beyond prompting.

- Judgment on deterministic automation versus AI, human review, quality, cost, latency and sensitive data.

- Major CRM administration, including data, workflows, reporting and integrations; HubSpot is strongly preferred.

- Familiarity with sales engagement platforms such as Amplemarket, Outreach or Salesloft, and ability to learn new tools.

- Careful ownership of commercial outcomes and technical reliability, balancing operations with development and communicating across commercial and technical stakeholders.

Nice to haves

- Experience with n8n, Make, Zapier or similar platforms.

- Building lightweight web applications and internal interfaces.

- Integrating LLM APIs, structured outputs or tool calling.

- Familiarity with data warehouses, BI tools and enrichment providers.

- Experience in fintech, payments or fast-growing B2B companies.

- A good sense of humor.

Why Clara

- A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

- Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

- An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

- English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

- Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

- Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

- Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

- Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

- ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

- Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

What you'll do

We're hiring a Sales Enablement Specialist in Sales Operations to own the Sales Academy, from onboarding through a three-month ramp and ongoing enablement. You'll build its curriculum, performance measurement and AI-powered app so new hires can turn learning into sales results.

How you'll work

You'll partner with Sales leadership and subject matter experts to turn real examples, strong call recordings and proven plays into training. Run end-of-cohort retrospectives with new hires and their sales leaders to improve the Academy.

Nice to haves

Why Clara

jobs.description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

About the Role

We are looking for a finance professional who refuses to be just a gatekeeper. This role is not about data entry; it is about Data Architecture and Business Strategy.

You will act as the de-facto Finance Lead for the Engage vertical, bridging the gap between strict Audit compliance and aggressive Sales targets. We need a "builder"—someone who can construct complex financial models, automate reporting logic, and sit across the table from Business Heads to drive P&L decisions.

Roles and Responsibilities

- Strategic Revenue Modelling

- Revenue Modelling: Manage complex revenue recognition models You will be responsible for maintaining the logic that allows us to recognize revenue progressively rather than as a lump sum.

- Sales Enablement: Act as a POC to the Sales team. Maintain and upgrade "Scenario Simulators" that help Key Account Managers structure profitable deals and predict their incentive achievements in real-time.

- Controllership & Audit Management

- Audit lead: Take ownership of the statutory audit for the division. You must be able to defend complex revenue positions to external auditors with deep technical rationale (IFRS/IndAS).

- Month-End Precision: Own the month-end close process. Ensure 100% accuracy in accruals and provisions, minimizing the timeline between month-end and final reporting.

- Working Capital & Cash Flow

- Liquidity Management: Monitor the AP/AR split to ensure the division remains cash-flow positive, proactively flagging liquidity risks to the central treasury

- Automation & Process Design

- Reporting Architecture: Move away from manual Excel dependencies. Maintain and build live dashboards (Looker/Excel) to give leadership a real-time view of "Forecast vs. Actuals."

- Process Improvement: Identify bottlenecks in billing or reconciliation (e.g., Engineering/Product gaps) and lead cross-functional projects to fix them permanently.

Mandatory Qualifications

- Education: CA / ACCA / MBA (Finance) or equivalent from a reputed institute.

- Experience: 2–4 years of experience. Prior exposure to Fintech, SaaS, or high-transaction environments is a massive plus.

- Advanced Excel: VLOOKUPs, Index-Match, Pivot Tables and Advanced Excel fluency. You must know how to build models that don't crash under heavy data.

- Data Fluency: Basic knowledge of SQL or experience with BI tools (Looker/PowerBI) is highly desirable.

- Compliance: Strong grasp of Revenue Recognition standards (IndAS 115).

- First-Principles Thinker: You don't just follow the process; you ask, "Why does this process exist?" and fix it if it's broken. You are able to formulate new methodologies and come up with better fixes to problems on the go.

- Effective Communicator: You can explain complex accounting constraints to a sales head without using jargon.

- Mentor Mindset: Ability to guide and upskill interns/junior analysts, fostering a culture of ownership within the team.

jobs.description:
Talkdesk competes in a market where the quality of execution separates companies that grow efficiently from those that spend more to get the same result. Marketing Operations is where that execution lives. This role exists to ensure that every dollar of marketing spend, every campaign, every event, and every account-based program translates into pipeline with zero friction. That requires a system built for precision where the right prospect reaches the right person at the right time, consistently and by design.

You sit inside the Marketing team, with close partnerships across Sales and RevOps. The marketers running campaigns, events, and account-based programs are your primary stakeholders. When the system works, their work converts.

In practice, that means owning the full operational surface of marketing technology: administering and continuously improving the tools that make up our GTM stack, building and maintaining the integrations that keep data moving cleanly between systems, designing the orchestrations that automate account and contact engagement, ensuring the enrichment and data integrity standards that make every downstream decision reliable. This is an interdependent system, and this person keeps it running as a coherent, high-performing whole.

What You'll Own

- Account-Based Marketing Orchestration: Serve as the technical owner of our ABM orchestration layer. Translate signals from our intent platform into automated, sequenced actions across our marketing automation platform and CRM, working closely with campaign and field marketing teams to ensure the right programs reach the right accounts at the right moment. Getting this infrastructure right is one of the highest-impact contributions this role makes to the business.

- Marketing Technology Foundation: Own the day-to-day health of our martech systems and the workflows, API calls, integrations, and syncs that connect them to keep prospect data moving accurately through the funnel. When something breaks or underperforms, you diagnose it, fix it, and document the resolution so it does not recur.

- Agentic AI Workflow Engineering: Design and build automated workflows that use AI capabilities to evaluate qualitative signals, such as demo request notes, intent activity, and unstructured form inputs, alongside firmographic data to produce dynamic lead scores and routing decisions. You write the API calls, design the orchestration logic, test against edge cases, and iterate based on conversion outcomes. Experience shipping something to production is the bar.

- Enrichment and Insights: Build and manage the workflows that construct a complete, account-level intelligence profile from the moment a prospect engages. That means aggregating first-party behavioral signals, third-party intent data, firmographic context, and web research into a unified view that captures not just the individual contact but the broader buying committee: who across the account is engaging, with what content, and what their activity suggests about organizational priorities and pain points. That intelligence surfaces in the systems where sales and marketing work, so every follow-up is informed, relevant, and timed to the account's buying journey.

- System Documentation and Enablement: Every workflow you build or modify gets documented: field mapping dictionaries, AI orchestration logic, routing rule change logs. Beyond documentation, you actively invest in making the marketing team more self-sufficient, building self-service reporting and dashboards that allow marketers to check campaign performance, list quality, or lead status independently, and creating resources that allow colleagues to troubleshoot routine tasks and leverage AI tools without filing a request. An empowered marketing team operates with greater speed and confidence, and this role contributes meaningfully to that outcome.

Who You Are

You operate with a high degree of autonomy. You are embedded in the relevant standups, attentive to system performance, and typically ahead of issues before they surface as escalations. Your manager will set context and priorities; the execution is yours to own.

You are invested in the success of the Marketing team. You understand that the campaigns, events, and programs your colleagues execute are only as effective as the systems that support them. Leads from a field event that go unrouted, an ABM sequence that executes against incomplete data, or a high-intent inbound request that experiences significant delay before reaching an SDR all represent measurable pipeline impact. You approach your work with that accountability in mind.

You are technically strong and collaborative by nature. Marketers, Sales and RevOps are close partners. You understand their workflows well enough to anticipate where system gaps will affect their work, and communicate clearly when something is broken, when it is fixed, and why. Strong cross-functional relationships are central to this role.

You see the work through to completion. You build, test, document, and close the loop. When something you own regresses, you identify it first.

What We're Looking For

Required

- 3 to 5 years in B2B SaaS Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, or a systems-adjacent role

- Hands-on marketing automation and CRM administration, including configuring and maintaining MAP-to-CRM syncs

- Demonstrated ability to build and deploy an automated workflow that calls external APIs, whether webhooks, REST APIs, or LLM endpoints, in a production environment

- Native fluency in B2B funnel mechanics: MQL definitions, lifecycle stage transitions, opportunity lifecycles, and attribution models

- Experience coaching or enabling non-technical stakeholders on new tools, AI workflows, or self-service reporting

Strong Signal

- Hands-on administrative experience with intent data platforms, routing engines, and ABM orchestration

- Prior experience building LLM-powered workflows for lead scoring, routing, or qualification

- Comfort reading and writing JSON, working with REST APIs, and debugging integration errors independently

How We'll Measure Success

The through-line across all of it is pipeline efficiency: more of the right prospects converting into pipeline from the programs already running, with less manual intervention and less fallout.

30 days: Full audit of marketing automation-to-CRM field mapping is complete, ownership of inbound routing rules is established, and current ABM workflow patterns are mapped to identify key automation opportunities.

60 days: First agentic AI workflow is deployed to staging or production. At least one major ABM orchestration sequence that previously required manual steps is automated. An initial self-service enablement resource or dashboard is delivered to the marketing team.

90 days and beyond: Lead sync exception rate is at target with a monitoring process that catches regressions before Sales does. ABM orchestration operates as a reliable service layer that campaign and field marketers can brief and trust to execute. Marketing colleagues actively leverage self-service tools and AI workflows independently.

Application Question

Required with your resume (200 words max):

A high-intent prospect submits a demo request but never reaches the assigned SDR in the CRM. Walk us through your exact diagnostic process: which logs you check first, how you trace the break across the marketing automation-to-CRM sync and inbound routing rules, how you validate the fix, and how you would design an agentic step to evaluate the prospect's form submission notes for priority routing.

- Provides operational and patient support to the Care Coordination team as needed.

- 1–2 years of experience in care coordination, patient support, customer support, or case management.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with patients, providers, and facility stakeholders.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment and adapting to changing priorities.

jobs.summary: Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time: Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina.
jobs.description:
Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time:

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Seu Cardápio Diário:

O Data Security Specialist é um profissional técnico responsável pela execução e operação dos controles de segurança de dados corporativos e de produção do iFood. Essa posição atua na interseção entre engenharia de segurança, proteção de dados e execução técnica — implementando controles, investigando incidentes e operando as ferramentas que protegem os ativos de dados do iFood.
O Data Security Specialist executa as operações de segurança de dados, impulsiona a adoção de AI nos fluxos de trabalho diários de segurança e garante que as capacidades de proteção de dados acompanhem o crescimento do iFood. É uma posição de contribuidor individual que exige experiência prática comprovada em engenharia de segurança de dados, com capacidade de atuar tanto no ambiente corporativo quanto no de produção.

Segurança de Dados Corporativos

- Operar e evoluir os controles de DLP (Data Loss Prevention) e ZTNA (Zero Trust Network Access) para endpoints, aplicações em cloud e canais de comunicação — implementando políticas, ajustando regras e executando as prioridades trimestrais.

- Implementar e fazer cumprir políticas de classificação de dados e procedimentos de tratamento para usuários internos e terceiros, garantindo alinhamento com LGPD, GDPR e requisitos regulatórios (BACEN, PCI-DSS, entre outros).

- Configurar e manter os controles de segurança para plataformas corporativas de SaaS: Databricks, Salesforce, Google Workspace, outras plataformas e ferramentas emergentes baseadas em AI — estabelecendo baselines de hardening, controles de acesso e governança de configuração.

- Implementar e fazer cumprir políticas de Document Retention & Disposal — estabelecendo cronogramas de retenção, procedimentos de descarte e mecanismos automatizados de aplicação.

- Executar o programa de insider threat: ajustar regras de behavioral analytics, conduzir cadências de análise de anomalias e coordenar com HR e Legal os casos de risco elevado.

- Gerenciar políticas de device posture e a aplicação de ZTNA, garantindo o acesso de dispositivos em conformidade em todo o ambiente corporativo.

Segurança de Dados de Produção

- Conduzir revisões de segurança da arquitetura de dados de produção: avaliar integrações de dados entre sistemas internos, parceiros e clientes, identificando riscos em APIs, pipelines de ETL e padrões de transferência de arquivos.

- Executar o workstream de Data Security no processo de Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), atuando de forma cross-functional com a equipe de IT Risk e contribuindo continuamente para a melhoria dos security review gates, dos requisitos contratuais de segurança e do monitoramento contínuo dos arranjos de troca de dados com terceiros.

- Promover security-by-design nas equipes de engenharia e dados: incorporar requisitos de proteção de dados aos padrões de desenho de integrações, aos frameworks de governança de APIs e aos controles de data residency.

- Garantir que data residency, criptografia em trânsito e em repouso e modelos de controle de acesso atendam às obrigações regulatórias e contratuais em todos os ambientes de produção.

- Apoiar os programas de conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR, PCI-DSS) relacionados à proteção de dados, atuando como ponto de contato técnico de Data Security para as equipes de Legal, Compliance e Audit.

Adoção de AI e Resultados Mensuráveis

- Impulsionar a adoção de AI nos fluxos de trabalho de Data Security: implementar ferramentas de AI para detecção de padrões anômalos de dados, classificação automatizada de dados, ajuste de políticas de DLP e aceleração de investigações — com melhorias mensuráveis na velocidade de detecção, na redução de falsos positivos e na produtividade dos analistas.

- Contribuir para o workstream de Data Security para AI Security, atuando de forma cross-functional com a equipe de AI Security para melhorar continuamente a governança e definir requisitos de proteção de dados para ferramentas de AI, incluindo casos de uso aprovados, tratamento de dados sensíveis em prompts, controles de acesso, monitoramento e padrões de adoção.

- Acompanhar e reportar os resultados impulsionados por AI: quantificar o tempo economizado, os riscos detectados mais cedo e as melhorias na precisão da classificação atribuíveis às ferramentas de AI.

Colaboração Cross-functional e Resposta a Incidentes

- Atuar como referência técnica de Data Security para as equipes adjacentes: traduzir cenários complexos de riscos relacionados a dados em atualizações claras e contextualizadas pelo impacto no negócio para o Data Security Manager e para os times de segurança.

- Construir e manter o dashboard operacional de Data Security: tendências de risco, taxas de violações de políticas, SLAs de remediação, métricas de adoção de AI e status operacional.

- Participar de iniciativas cross-functional de Data Security: coordenar com Legal, Product, Engineering e IT para equilibrar requisitos de segurança e velocidade do negócio — encontrando o caminho seguro que viabilize a entrega de produtos.

- Gerenciar solicitações de exceção de Data Security: avaliar exceções baseadas em risco às políticas de segurança, documentar recomendações e acompanhar o ciclo de vida das exceções.

- Atuar na resposta a incidentes como referência técnica de Data Security: conduzir a frente de investigação específica de dados durante incidentes de grande impacto, coordenar com o CSIRT e comunicar o impacto do risco relacionado a dados ao Data Security Manager.

Operação Técnica de Programas

- Executar o roadmap técnico de Data Security: traduzir as metas estratégicas em tarefas operacionais, gerenciar o acompanhamento de dependências e reportar o progresso ao Data Security Manager.

- Conduzir iniciativas de Sensitive Data Mapping: executar a descoberta, classificação e catalogação cross-functional de dados nos ambientes corporativos e de produção.

- Construir e manter métricas de Data Security: índices de exposição a riscos, tendências de violações de políticas, taxas de encerramento de alertas de DLP, SLAs de remediação e velocidade operacional.

- Documentar e manter runbooks, playbooks e procedimentos operacionais padrão para as operações de Data Security.

Ingredientes Que Buscamos:

- Experiência comprovada como Data Security Specialist, Analyst ou Engineer — com histórico de responsabilidade técnica por um domínio de Data Security.

- Forte experiência em proteção de dados, DLP, ZTNA e governança de segurança da informação.

- Sólida compreensão dos princípios de arquitetura Zero Trust e de sua implementação prática: ZTNA, conditional access, device posture e identity-based segmentation.

- Conhecimento profundo de hardening de segurança de SaaS corporativo: Google Workspace, Salesforce, Databricks, outras plataformas e plataformas emergentes baseadas em AI.

- Conhecimento de conceitos de arquitetura de dados: APIs, pipelines de ETL, data warehouses, plataformas de dados em cloud e padrões de troca de dados de produção.

- Familiaridade com frameworks regulatórios: LGPD, GDPR, PCI-DSS e requisitos regulatórios do BACEN e do PROUF.

- Experiência prática com ferramentas de AI para Data Security: detecção de anomalias, classificação automatizada, ajuste de DLP ou aceleração de investigações — com resultados tangíveis e mensuráveis documentados.

- Sólidas habilidades analíticas e investigativas: capacidade de rastrear um vazamento de dados, desde o sinal até a causa-raiz, e traduzir as descobertas em recomendações sistêmicas.

- Capacidade de colaboração cross-functional: aptidão para conduzir resultados técnicos em colaboração com Legal, Engineering, Product e IT, equilibrando requisitos de segurança e velocidade do negócio.

- Habilidade de documentação e criação de runbooks, playbooks e procedimentos operacionais para Data Security.

- Inglês avançado (obrigatório).

Para Realçar o Sabor:

- Experiência com plataformas SASE (Netskope, Zscaler ou similares) e ferramentas de DSPM (Netskope, Cyera, Wiz ou similares).

- Experiência em data engineering ou analytics — compreensão dos fluxos de dados por dentro, incluindo arquitetura de pipelines, data warehousing e plataformas de dados em tempo real.

- Experiência na adoção de AI em Data Security: implementação de ferramentas de AI para operações de segurança, mensuração de ganhos de produtividade e iteração das estratégias de adoção.

- Certificações: CISM, CDPSE, CISSP ou equivalente.

- Experiência em um setor regulado (fintech, banking, payments, health tech), com exposição prática à conformidade regulatória.

Buscamos uma pessoa apaixonada por segurança em tecnologia, que esteja sempre em busca de novos aprendizados e que goste de desafios. Se você se identifica com este perfil, adoraríamos conhecer você!

Warum wir es tun. Grüner. Fairer. Zukunftsorientierter.

Deine Mission:
Bei Octopus Electric Vehicles (OEV) Germany gestalten wir die Mobilität der Zukunft direkt am Arbeitsplatz. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die gerne beraten, Verantwortung übernehmen und Freude daran haben, gemeinsam etwas Neues aufzubauen.
Du bist die Verbindung zwischen unseren Firmenkund*innen und ihren Mitarbeitenden. Du berätst Mitarbeitende unserer Partnerunternehmen persönlich und auf Augenhöhe von der ersten Frage zu Elektrofahrzeugen und Ladetechnologie bis hin zur Bestellung. Du zeigst ihnen, was das für ihr Nettoeinkommen bedeutet und findest mit ihnen das passende Auto.
Wir bauen Octopus EV in Deutschland gerade auf. Du gestaltest also von Anfang an mit, wie gute Beratung bei uns aussieht. Dabei entwickelst du unseren Beratungsprozess weiter, bringst deine Ideen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Erfahrung für unsere Kund*innen einfach, persönlich und gut wird.

Individuelle Beratung von Mitarbeitenden: Du berätst Mitarbeitende persönlich zu Elektrofahrzeugen, Ladetechnologien und den steuerlichen Vorteilen ihres Arbeitgebermodells. Dabei begleitest du sie empathisch und kompetent von der ersten unverbindlichen Anfrage bis zur Bestellung ihres Wunschautos.

Vertrieb und Prozesse weiterentwickeln: Du bringst deine Erfahrungen aus den Beratungsgesprächen ein, um unsere Vertriebsprozesse und Beratungstools für den deutschen Markt kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Du erkennst, was Mitarbeitenden wichtig ist und hilfst uns dabei, unsere Abläufe entsprechend weiterzuentwickeln.

Wissen teilen und Verantwortung übernehmen: Mit dem Wachstum von OEV kannst du Verantwortung für neue Kolleg*innen übernehmen, dein Wissen über die Bedürfnisse von Firmenmitarbeitenden weitergeben und dabei helfen, unsere B2C-Teams für weiteres Wachstum aufzustellen.

Begeistern und präsentieren: Du behältst deine Gespräche und Kontakte im CRM im Blick und führst überzeugende virtuelle Informationsveranstaltungen für Mitarbeitende durch.

Beratung mit Fingerspitzengefühl: Du kannst komplexe Themen wie Versteuerung und Reichweite verständlich und anschaulich erklären. Du hörst aufmerksam zu, stellst die richtigen Fragen und findest gemeinsam mit Kund*innen die passende Lösung ohne ihnen etwas „aufschwatzen“ zu wollen.

Lust auf Neues: Du fühlst dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld wohl und packst gerne mit an. Wenn noch nicht alles perfekt organisiert ist, findest du pragmatische Lösungen und hilfst dabei, unsere Abläufe weiterzuentwickeln.

jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
 
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
 
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
 
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 

Stiamo cercando un* Junior Office Manager pragmatic*, energic* e super organizzat*.

Cerchiamo una persona con una grande attitudine pratica, la voglia di imparare e l'entusiasmo di "sporcarsi le mani" ogni giorno per far funzionare la nostra sede come un orologio, sempre con il sorriso e la voglia di creare un ambiente accogliente.

Sarai il punto di riferimento operativo per la vita quotidiana del nostro ufficio. In questo ruolo c’è da rimboccarsi le maniche e gestire aspetti sia pratici che logistici:

-
Gestione operativa dell'ufficio: dalla manutenzione quotidiana al riordino degli spazi, dal monitoraggio delle forniture (cancelleria, snack, dotazioni) alla risoluzione dei piccoli e grandi imprevisti pratici di ogni giorno.

-
Interfaccia con fornitori e manutentori: sarai tu a coordinare gli interventi tecnici, i servizi di pulizia e la sicurezza, assicurandoti che tutto sia sempre efficiente e a norma.

-
Accoglienza e logistica: accoglierai ospiti, candidati e colleghi, gestirai la posta/corrieri e ti assicurerai che le sale riunioni e le postazioni siano sempre pronte ed equipaggiate.

-
Supporto al team e agli eventi: darai un aiuto concreto nell'organizzazione dei momenti di condivisione aziendali come il nostro Family Dinner del venerdì!

-
Proattività quotidiana: non aspetterai che siano gli altri a notare che qualcosa non va: ti anticipi, trovi soluzioni semplici e ti assicuri che l'ufficio sia un posto fantastico in cui lavorare.

-
Attitudine da “risolutore di problemi” e concretezza: non hai paura di metterti in gioco in prima persona, ti piace l'operatività e trovi soddisfazione nel risolvere i problemi sul campo in modo rapido e pratico.

-
Profilo Junior / Primi anni di esperienza: sei all'inizio della tua carriera o hai una breve esperienza in contesti operativi, di accoglienza, retail, hospitality o supporto organizzativo, ma soprattutto hai una gran voglia di imparare e crescere in un contesto veloce.

-
Energia e spirito di iniziativa: sei una persona dinamica, solare e positiva. Se c'è da spostare uno scatolone, riordinare una sala o gestire un'emergenza dell'ultimo minuto, sei il* prim* a dare una mano.

-
Precisione e doti organizzative: anche nel caos saprai prioritizzare le urgenze e tenere tutto sotto controllo senza perdere il filo.

-
Presenza e cura degli spazi: ami lavorare di persona a contatto con la gente. Questo è un ruolo 100% in presenza: l'ufficio è il tuo "regno" e ti piace prendertene cura in prima persona.

In Octopus fare bene il tuo lavoro è naturale: trovi le condizioni giuste per esprimerti al meglio, perché i tuoi obiettivi, quelli dei colleghi e quelli dell’azienda sono perfettamente allineati.

Lavorerai con persone curiose, brillanti e concrete, che hanno voglia di fare bene e migliorare davvero le cose.

Lavorerai per un’azienda che le persone scelgono perché si fidano: abbiamo un servizio clienti valutato 4,9/5 su Trustpilot e premiato da Altroconsumo e dal Corriere della Sera.

Farai parte di una realtà concreta, veloce e poco burocratica, dove contano i risultati, il modo in cui li raggiungiamo e l’impatto che creiamo per i clienti.

-
Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza.

-
Equity Options Scheme: in Octopus puoi avere accesso a opzioni su azioni del Gruppo. In pratica, puoi possedere la tua parte di Octopus Energy e partecipare al valore che costruiamo insieme.

-
Focus sul tuo benessere: ti supportiamo con vantaggi concreti come i buoni pasto e un accesso gratuito a sessioni di benessere psicologico.

-
Cultura: ogni settimana, il venerdì, ci riuniamo tutti per gli aggiornamenti aziendali e un brindisi. Lo chiamiamo Family Dinner.

Octopus Energy Generation (OEGEN) is a leader in sourcing, investing in, and managing a wide range of utility-scale renewable energy assets. We are looking for an Energy Markets Specialist to provide senior commercial and market expertise across OEGEN’s renewable portfolio. The role will have particular responsibility for overseeing energy-market activity for a key fund and more broadly building OEGEN’s strategic BESS capability.
Working across Asset Management, Fund Management, Investment and Technical teams, the successful candidate will translate increasingly complex energy markets into clear commercial recommendations. Lead energy-market coverage for ORIT, including route-to-market performance, revenue strategy, hedging, market risk and key commercial counterparties

Build OEGEN’s BESS commercial strategy across priority markets, including revenue underwriting, route-to-market, optimiser selection and risk management

-
Provide senior market input into investment decisions, challenging assumptions on power prices, capture prices, ancillary services, balancing, negative pricing, grid constraints and commercial structures

-
Develop clear standards and guidance for BESS and collocated assets, ensuring lessons from operational assets are reflected in new investment assumptions

Lead or oversee complex commercial processes, including optimiser, route-to-market and strategic PPA tenders; work with external providers to deliver routine contracting efficiently where appropriate

Monitor energy-market, regulatory and policy developments across OEGEN’s priority markets, identifying risks and opportunities for funds and assets

-
Work closely with Fund Asset Directors and Fund Management teams to develop and implement market strategies that support fund objectives, investor returns and risk appetite

Manage relationships with traders, optimisers, balancing parties, advisers and other key commercial partners, holding them to account for performance

Experience leading complex commercial processes and managing external counterparties, including PPA, route-to-market, optimiser or trading arrangements

Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present commercial recommendations to senior management, Investment Committee and investors

jobs.description:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.
 
Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer.

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.

Tu as envie de rejoindre une entreprise qui grandit vite, avec beaucoup d’autonomie et une façon assez différente de faire les People Ops ?
Bienvenue chez Octopus Energy France.
Chez nous, nous fonctionnons selon un modèle NoHR : les managers sont le premier point de contact people de leurs équipes. Le rôle de l’équipe People Ops est de leur donner le bon cadre, les bons outils, les bonnes informations et les bons réflexes pour qu’ils puissent être autonomes au quotidien.
Dans ce contexte, nous cherchons aujourd’hui quelqu’un de solide en People Ops, capable à la fois de construire et faire évoluer nos façons de travailler, mais aussi de contribuer concrètement au quotidien de l’équipe.
Le poste est organisé autour de deux grands volets, qui représentent chacun environ 50 % du rôle :
du build : projets People, outils, data, automatisation, IA, amélioration de nos process
du run : administration du personnel, paie, support aux managers et aux équipes, contrôle et fiabilisation des données
Cet équilibre n’est évidemment pas figé : selon les actualités, les projets ou les périodes de l’année, tu pourras passer davantage de temps sur l’un ou l’autre.
Ce qu’on cherche surtout, c’est quelqu’un qui aime construire des choses sans perdre le contact avec l’opérationnel.

1. Build : faire évoluer nos People Ops

Une partie importante de ton rôle sera de prendre en main des projets qui permettent à l’équipe People Ops et aux managers de travailler mieux, plus simplement et plus efficacement.

Tu pourras notamment :

-
piloter des projets People de bout en bout, de l’identification du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

-
simplifier et améliorer nos process

-
construire et faire évoluer notre Help Hub et notre documentation

-
construire des dashboards et des reportings utiles au pilotage : consolider et mieux exploiter les données issues de nos différents outils

-
automatiser certains contrôles, reportings ou tâches répétitives

-
identifier et tester des cas d’usage simples autour de l’IA et de l’automatisation

-
participer à des projets Groupe avec les équipes Octopus basées notamment au Royaume-Uni

-
accompagner les managers dans l’adoption de nouveaux outils ou de nouvelles façons de travailler

On cherche quelqu’un qui aime partir d’un besoin parfois encore un peu flou, le comprendre, le structurer et arriver à une solution concrète.

La data et l’IA sont des outils au service des People Ops et des équipes, pas une fin en soi. Nous ne cherchons donc ni un·e Data Analyst pur, ni un profil tech, mais quelqu’un qui sait s’en servir pour résoudre des problèmes opérationnels.

2. Run : contribuer au quotidien de l’équipe

L’autre moitié du poste consiste à être pleinement partie prenante des People Ops du quotidien.

Selon les besoins de l’équipe, tu pourras intervenir sur :

-
l’administration du personnel : contrats, avenants, mouvements, absences, sorties…

-
la préparation et le contrôle de la paie

-
le contrôle et la cohérence des données entre nos différents outils

-
les questions des managers et des salarié·es

-
le suivi et la résolution de sujets opérationnels

-
le support à l’équipe lors des périodes de forte activité ou lorsqu’un sujet urgent apparaît

L’idée n’est pas de te spécialiser dans l’administration ou la paie. En revanche, tu dois être à l’aise pour mettre les mains dedans, comprendre les sujets et apporter du support à l’équipe lorsque c’est nécessaire.

Chez nous, le run est aussi une source importante pour le build : c’est souvent en étant confronté·e aux irritants du quotidien qu’on identifie ce qu’il faut simplifier, automatiser ou repenser.

- tu as au moins 7 ans d’expérience en People Ops, HR Operations ou sur un rôle généraliste avec une forte dimension opérationnelle

-
tu as un très bon niveau d’anglais à l’oral (minimum B2-C1), indispensable pour travailler avec les équipes Octopus à l’international

-
tu as déjà travaillé dans un environnement start-up / scale-up, où il faut savoir naviguer dans l’ambiguïté, s’adapter vite et avancer sans que tout soit parfaitement cadré

-
tu es à l’aise avec le run People Ops : administration du personnel, paie, contrôle de données, support aux managers et aux équipes

-
tu es à l’aise avec la data et sais l’utiliser pour fiabiliser, analyser et mieux piloter

-
tu as déjà piloté des projets People et/ou outils, de la définition du besoin jusqu’à la mise en œuvre

-
tu es très à l’aise avec Google Sheets / Excel et, plus largement, avec un environnement de travail digital : Google Workspace, Slack, MacBook…

-
tu es pragmatique : tu cherches des solutions simples, utiles et réellement utilisables

-
tu es autonome, à l’aise dans un environnement qui bouge vite, et capable de prioriser entre projets de fond et sujets opérationnels plus urgents

Pour être transparent, ce poste ne correspondra probablement pas à quelqu’un qui cherche :

-
un poste de Data Analyst / People Analyst pur

-
un rôle uniquement centré sur les projets, sans envie de contribuer au run

-
un poste principalement orienté paie ou administration du personnel

-
un poste purement tech

-
un rôle très stratégique ou de management, éloigné du quotidien des opérations

Nous cherchons quelqu’un de polyvalent et solide en People Ops, qui peut aussi bien passer une matinée à faire avancer un projet outil ou data qu’une après-midi à aider l’équipe sur de la paie, une incohérence de données ou une question manager.

The Process: The installation sequence and what we need to see to sign it off.
The Finish Line: What’s required to get the data flowing and officially go live.

The Installers: They are independent contractors, usually chosen and hired directly by the housing association or delivery partner.
Octopus: We support the model by setting the technical standards, design rules, and go-live conditions.

jobs.summary: Chi siamo Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte.
jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
 
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
 
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
 
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 

Il ruolo
Nelle compagnie energetiche tradizionali, quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, spesso passa da un reparto all’altro, ripete le stesse informazioni e aspetta che qualcuno rimetta insieme i pezzi.
In Octopus lavoriamo in modo diverso: usiamo tecnologia, dati e lavoro di squadra per avere le informazioni giuste al momento giusto, ridurre i passaggi inutili e seguire ogni richiesta dall’inizio alla fine.
Sarai il punto di riferimento del cliente. Ascolterai le sue esigenze, userai la tecnologia e gli strumenti a disposizione, collaborerai con il tuo team e accompagnerai il cliente fino alla soluzione.
È un ruolo che unisce relazione, ragionamento e operatività. Servono empatia, giudizio, flessibilità e senso di responsabilità.
Non serve avere già esperienza nel settore energetico. Molte delle persone che oggi lavorano in questo ruolo sono entrate senza conoscerlo: ti daremo formazione, strumenti e supporto per imparare passo dopo passo.
 

⚡ Renderai l’energia più semplice. Aiuterai i clienti a capire bollette, contatori, tariffe e pratiche senza usare parole incomprensibili e senza complicazioni.

💡 Troverai soluzioni concrete. Userai tecnologia, portali e lavoro di squadra per gestire anche i casi più complessi.

📞 Seguirai il cliente dall’inizio alla fine. Niente rimbalzi tra reparti: ti prenderai cura di ogni richiesta fino alla soluzione, reclami inclusi. Lo aiuterai al telefono, via e-mail e su WhatsApp.

🧠 Ragionerai con la tua testa. Niente copioni, niente risposte automatiche: solo conversazioni vere, in cui ascolti, capisci e trovi la risposta più utile.

❤️ Aiuterai ogni cliente come aiuteresti tua nonna. Con chiarezza, gentilezza e voglia di fare un passo in più, perché per noi il servizio clienti si fa così.

🌍 Farai la differenza. Che tu stia aiutando qualcuno a capire meglio la propria bolletta o a scegliere soluzioni energetiche più consapevoli, il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto concreto.

Guarda il video per conoscerci meglio: Presentazione Energy Specialist

-
Ti piace aiutare le persone, davvero: ti dà soddisfazione capire un’esigenza, sciogliere un dubbio e risolvere un problema.

-
Sai ascoltare e comunicare in modo semplice, diretto e umano, anche quando devi spiegare temi complessi o gestire situazioni delicate.

-
Non devi conoscere già il settore energetico: conta di più la voglia di imparare, capire i problemi e trovare soluzioni.

-
Prendi iniziativa, non ti fermi alla prima difficoltà e ti piace seguire un caso dall’inizio alla fine.

-
Ti riconosci in un modo di lavorare che mette insieme tecnologia, responsabilità personale e lavoro di squadra.

-
In Octopus fare bene il tuo lavoro è naturale: trovi le condizioni giuste per esprimerti al meglio, perché i tuoi obiettivi, quelli dei colleghi e quelli dell’azienda sono perfettamente allineati

-
Lavorerai con persone curiose, brillanti e concrete, che hanno voglia di fare bene e migliorare davvero le cose.

-
Lavorerai per un’azienda che le persone scelgono perché si fidano: abbiamo un servizio clienti valutato 4,9/5 su Trustpilot e premiato da Altroconsumo e dal Corriere della Sera.

-
Farai parte di una realtà concreta, veloce e poco burocratica, dove contano i risultati, il modo in cui li raggiungiamo e l’impatto che creiamo per i clienti.

-
Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza.

-
Equity Options Scheme: in Octopus puoi avere accesso a opzioni su azioni del Gruppo. In pratica, puoi possedere la tua parte di Octopus Energy e partecipare al valore che costruiamo insieme.

-
Focus sul tuo benessere: ti supportiamo con vantaggi concreti come i buoni pasto e un accesso gratuito a sessioni di benessere psicologico.

-
Cultura: ogni settimana, il venerdì, ci riuniamo tutti per gli aggiornamenti aziendali e un brindisi. Lo chiamiamo Family Dinner.

- Sede: Roma

-
Disponibilità: immediata

-
Ore: Tempo pieno
